description: January 31 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 2, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 31 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the second decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: The January 31 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: The month's last day reduces to 4, giving Aquarius an unexpected practical anchor. With the Sun near eleven degrees of the sign and Mercury as decan sub-ruler, January 31 is linked with systems thinking: designing processes, tidying information and building tools. The independence of Aquarius stays, but it is channelled into reliable, repeatable work.

Astronomically, January 31 puts the Sun near 11° Aquarius in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aquarius the sub-ruler is Mercury, the ruler of Gemini. Birthdays from around January 30 to February 8 tend to bring a quick, communicative intelligence to the sign's idealism. Natives are often seen as witty, curious and well networked, the kind of person who knows someone in every group and enjoys connecting them. Writing, teaching and technical problem-solving are commonly associated with this decan. Mercury can make the mind race ahead of the body and the heart. Slowing down long enough to listen as well as explain usually deepens their many connections.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for January 31
paragraphs: Born on the 31st, your compound is 3 + 1 = 4. The 3 brings creativity and the 1 brings drive, and the 4 that results gives them a practical shape. People born on this day are often described as builders with imagination, able to design a plan and then see it through with steady effort. They tend to value loyalty and long-term commitment. In its supporting role, the 31 is traditionally associated with organising creative ideas into something lasting. Leaving room for spontaneity helps, since structure can harden into routine if nothing new is let in.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a January 31 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous January 31 birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 31 is the 31st day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Pisces, is usually complete within 19 days, by February 19.

Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by January 31 in 44 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it. Among the best-known people with a January 31 birthday are Franz Schubert (1797), Kenzaburō Ōe (1935) and Beatrix of the Netherlands (1938).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 31?
faq.answer: January 31 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 31?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 31 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 31st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 31?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, January 31 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 44 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 31?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on January 31 include Franz Schubert (1797), Kenzaburō Ōe (1935) and Beatrix of the Netherlands (1938). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
